preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000) representing the number of rounds.
Each of the next n lines contains exactly two space-separated tokens: a player name and a score.

preconditions.expression: all(line.split()[0].isalpha() and line.split()[0].islower() and 1 <= len(line.split()[0]) <= 32 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each player name is a string of lowercase Latin letters with length between 1 and 32.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each score is an integer between -1000 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() in {line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]}
postconditions.description: The output is the name of a player who participated in the game.

postconditions.expression: let rounds = stdin.splitlines()[1:]; let scores = {name: 0 for name in {line.split()[0] for line in rounds}}; let cumulative = []; for line in rounds: name, score = line.split(); scores[name] += int(score); cumulative.append((name, scores[name])); let max_score = max(scores.values()); let max_players = [name for name, score in scores.items() if score == max_score]; let first_to_reach = None; for name, score in cumulative: if score >= max_score and name in max_players: first_to_reach = name; break; stdout.strip() == first_to_reach if first_to_reach is not None else max_players[0]
postconditions.description: The output is the name of the player with the maximum cumulative score. If multiple players have the maximum score, the output is the name of the player who first reached or exceeded that score in any round.
